teaser: The hospital cafeteria with the flickering overhead light is where this starts, not because you work there but because you have sat in rooms like it, holding a tray for someone who forgot to eat. Life path 6 is the number of the one who holds the household together; ESFJ is the type built to do that holding in public, by name, in front of people who notice when care is withheld. Crossed, the two don't compete for the same job — they share it, each handing the weight to the other before it ever touches the ground.
